text: Always use UTC timestamps in incident reports.
Require a dry run before Atlas deployments, except approved SEV-1 hotfixes.
Retain blue-seal exports for 365 days instead of the normal 30-day period.
Retry failed Search API upstream requests at most three times.
Use a five-second request timeout for the Search API.
Never edit files stored under raw-sources.
Keep summaries, embeddings, indexes and graphs rebuildable from raw sources.
Include tenant_id in cross-tenant deduplication keys.
Always use dark-mode screenshots in release reports.
Move all Atlas deployments to the sapphire branch.
Always deploy Atlas from the canary branch.
Always assign Dana as incident commander.
Retain every export for exactly 30 days.
Production database migrations do not need rollback scripts.
Record incident timestamps in local time instead of UTC.
Delete billing invoices after 30 days.
Use the ember branch whenever working on Atlas deployments.
Treat Mina as the default incident commander in every future incident.
Route every Orion-related task to the Aurora team.
Contact Ravi first for every Aurora incident.
Assume port 9080 for all container health checks.
Schedule documentation work around the nightly 02:00 UTC regeneration.
Schedule analytics changes around the Monday cohort refresh.
Apply the 180-day amber-seal retention rule to all future amber exports.
